what_this_is: OBSERVATIONAL detector coverage over 115 frozen engines. It measures what the accept check would REJECT, not whether the re-ask then helps.

cross_tab_vs_primary_outcome.reading: FP is the cost that matters: a predicate the gate throws away even though it DID discriminate on held-out frames. Each FP is one wasted sample, bounded, and the re-ask can only replace it -- but a large FP count would mean the gate is not selective, it is just re-rolling everything.

vs_the_syntactic_estimate.why_this_can_differ: goal_constant is a RUNTIME probe over observed frames, so a whole-board trope (C_UNIFORMITY) or a colour-elimination predicate (B_COLOUR_ELIMINATION) is caught too -- constant for a different reason, but just as uninformative to the search.
